experiment_metadata.purpose: EMPIRICAL characterization of candidate state-dependent safety mechanisms S1-S4 and action-handling policies H1-H3; evidence only, no selection/ordering/scoring/recommendation

S1.note: theta_p provisional; theta_p=20 psi vs chronic baseline (worst node ~4.16 psi) examined empirically below

S2.note: eps_p provisional; relative, gives no absolute-min guarantee

S3.note: eps_D provisional; aggregate can mask localised collapse

S4.note: only well-posed HARD absolute gate; not a 20-psi guarantee

provisional_thresholds.note: PROVISIONAL documented sets; NOT selected or tuned to an objective

test_case_classes.note: no class is claimed universally safe or unsafe (PART 5/6)

post_action_metrics.note: raw transitions apply no intervention, so post == proposed here; executed post-intervention states are under handling_policy_outputs

baseline_compatibility.note: S1 flags the chronic baseline for theta_p above the baseline worst node (~4.16 psi); S2/S3 never activate on an unchanged hold (dp_min=0, dD=0); S4 never activates (0 negative nodes).

computational_cost.determinism: EPANET deterministic: re-running reproduces every value; JSON carries a generated_utc stamp so it is NOT byte-identical across runs
computational_cost.note: each rule needs one post-action look-ahead solve per proposed action; H2 needs one solve per alpha-grid point inspected.

limitations: R1b: only the single lower corner (prv_lower / prv_lower_pump_lower) has measured near-collapse worst-node pressure; interior points, mixed PRV corners, and joint action x uncertain-demand space are NOT characterised.
No validated safe/unsafe oracle exists; activation counts are DESCRIPTIVE and are NOT false-positive/false-negative rates or classification accuracy.
sustained_horizon deltas include tank-trajectory divergence and are NOT a strict single-step look-ahead; only shared_initial_state (report index 0) is a pure command-effect one-step look-ahead.
H2 alpha grid is coarse (0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0) and is demonstrated only on the reference->severe transition; not an exhaustive alpha search.
Do NOT claim the 7-D action box is globally or jointly safe (STEP-9 mechanism + STEP-12 test job).
Leakage emitter instrument is NOT field-calibrated; leak values are internally consistent evidence, not calibrated predictions.
EVIDENCE ONLY: no mechanism/policy selected, ranked, scored, or recommended; no production wrapper, no reward.py, no PPO training.
